source: Recorded accepted M12B-004C dev, validation, and permanent-regression outputs; no generation was run.

languageInteraction.claim: The simulated guard rejects literal-corrupting outputs; it does not improve or replace language resolution.

details.output: Para ver os logs, execute o comando `ls -l` no terminal.

addedProtectedLikeLiterals.note: These are indicators, not automatic invented-information findings; list numbering and structural labels can be benign.

selectionIsolation.note: Only selected input spans were token-compared; the counterfactual does not change selection behavior.

rDollar.currentAcceptedBehavior: M12B-004C preflight returns noChange and preserves R$.
rDollar.futureBenchmarkCorrection: Consider mustPreserveTokens: ["R$"] after maintainer review; frozen corpus was not modified.

recommendation.label: Implement protection only for a narrower subset of token classes
recommendation.reason: High-confidence structural and factual literals support a simple reject-to-noChange guard. Exact standalone-integer deletion is also supported; locale-sensitive date and formatted/decimal-number rewriting needs positive controls.
